an01.name: Open gold-tone ring with two flowers
an01.description: Open ring in a gold tone with two small flowers at the ends.
an01.story: An open ring crowned by two small gold-tone flowers: delicate, adjustable and full of spring charm. It fits the finger comfortably.

an02.name: Wide textured gold-tone band ring
an02.description: Open wide-band ring in a gold tone with a textured surface.
an02.story: A wide gold-tone band with a textured surface that plays with the light: a ring with presence and an artisanal-style finish. Open for a comfortable fit.

an03.name: Gold-tone starfish ring with pearl
an03.description: Open ring in a gold tone with a starfish, a white pearl and a clear stone.
an03.story: A gold-tone starfish accompanied by a white pearl and a clear stone on an open ring: all the charm of the sea on your hand. Original and very feminine.

an04.name: Wide gold-tone ring with oval medallion
an04.description: Multi-band gold-tone ring with an oval medallion at the center.
an04.story: Multiple gold-tone bands holding a polished oval medallion: an architectural, modern ring with plenty of presence. For bold styles.

an05.name: Gold-tone wavy bands ring
an05.description: Open ring in a gold tone with interlaced wavy bands.
an05.story: Wavy, organic gold-tone bands that interlace fluidly: a sculptural, artistic ring for those looking for something different.

an06.name: Silver-tone ring with leaf relief
an06.description: Wide-band silver-tone ring with an overlapping leaf relief.
an06.story: A silver-tone leaf in soft relief that wraps the finger: a natural, elegant design on a wide, flattering band. Fresh and contemporary.

an07.name: Open silver-tone shell ring with pearl
an07.description: Open silver-tone ring with a ridged shell at one end and a white pearl at the other.
an07.story: A ridged shell and a white pearl at the ends of an open silver-tone ring: the sea in miniature, for every day. Delicate and original.
highlights: White pearl at the other end

an08.name: Open silver-tone ring with oval ends
an08.description: Open silver-tone ring with a ribbed band and textured oval ends.
an08.story: A ribbed band with softly textured oval ends in a silver tone: a modern, tactile design that adjusts comfortably. Minimalism with detail.

an09.name: Gold-tone ring with pearls and braided spiral
an09.description: Gold-tone ring with a braid-textured spiral and three white pearls.
an09.story: A braid-textured gold-tone spiral adorned with three white pearls: movement, shine and softness in a romantic, original ring.

an10.name: Gold-tone interlaced ovals ring
an10.description: Wide-band gold-tone ring with interlaced polished ovals.
an10.story: Polished gold-tone ovals that interlock like scales on a wide band: a ring with rich texture and warm shine. Eye-catching and sophisticated.

an11.name: Open braided gold-tone ring
an11.description: Open ring in a gold tone with a braided-effect band.
an11.story: A braided-effect gold-tone band on an open, adjustable ring: artisanal-style texture with a warm, luminous finish. A classic with character.

an12.name: Gold-tone hammered leaf ring
an12.description: Gold-tone ring with a large hammered leaf that wraps the finger.
an12.story: A large gold-tone leaf with a hammered surface that curves over the finger: a bold, sculptural botanical piece. For those who are not afraid to stand out.
